stem: A nonqualified deferred annuity (not an IRA or employer plan) pays out before the holder reaches age 59½. Which of the following distributions is exempt from the 10% federal penalty?
options: A withdrawal to pay college tuition
A payment to the beneficiary after the holder's death
A withdrawal to buy a first home
A withdrawal made during the surrender charge period
key: A payment to the beneficiary after the holder's death
